_readme: Special badges the Hermit can give out (Hermit menu > Rewards). To add one: put a square PNG (128x128, transparent background) in images/badges/, add a line here, push. The id must be unique and never change (players keep it). Shown next to player names when they pick it. The normal achievement badges use px-*.png (32x32 pixel art, cut from art-source sheet 32x32.png on branch main, Raven Fantasy Icons by Clockwork Raven); their pictures are set on the server (badges.image), not listed here.
